Package org.drip.optimization.neldermead

Nelder-Mead Rd Function Optimization
Author:
Lakshmi Krishnamurthy
  • Class Summary
    Class Description
    AmoebaCoefficients
    AmoebaCoefficients maintains the Reflection, the Expansion, the Contraction, and the Shrink Coefficients employed in the Nelder-Mead Scheme.
    DownhillSimplex
    DownhillSimplex implements the the Canonical Nelder-Mead Scheme for Optimizing a Rd Function.
    DownhillSimplexIterationDiagnostics
    DownhillSimplexIterationDiagnostics maintains the Diagnostics associated with a Single Iteration inside the Downhill Simplex Scheme.
    DownhillSimplexRun
    DownhillSimplexVertexes holds the Evolving the Ordered Vertexes employed in the Nelder-Mead Scheme.
    DownhillSimplexRunDiagnostics
    DownhillSimplexRunDiagnostics maintains the Diagnostics associated with the Downhill Simplex Scheme.
    DownhillSimplexVertexes
    DownhillSimplexVertexes holds the Evolving the Ordered Vertexes employed in the Nelder-Mead Scheme.
    ObjectiveFunctionCoordinate
    ObjectiveFunctionCoordinate contains an Objective Function Coordinate and its Value.
